items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: We all belong to the same club, the Friendly Fifty.

ctx.x: I think he ought to do one of these things because he must have a lot of stories about Fletch.

Oh, he can. Yes, he can, because -- who covered him? Somebody, I think Doc Varner taped him, and we had a thing up there in Doc Varner's place at Larchmont four Saturdays ago, and they had this group from Sweden. People wanted to call in some of the jazz men, responsible for a lot of jazz work, and we had a beautiful turnout. Everybody played, took pictures (unintelligible) and all.
